messages.subject: Project Zephyr — technical due diligence questions
messages.plaintextBody:
Aisha,

Ahead of the pilot, a few technical points my team needs to close out:

1. Maximum concurrent AMRs the Core supports per site (we'll run ~180 at Lutterworth).
2. Which WMS adapters are production-ready — we're on Manhattan at Daventry and Blue Yonder at Peterborough.
3. Support coverage hours and the P1 response commitment.
4. Confirmation the benefit-reporting (Insight) methodology will be the basis for the royalty calc.

Thanks,
Tom

messages.snippet: Tom, Answers: 1. Core v6.2 supports up to 750 concurrent AMRs per site — 180 at Lutterworth is comfo
messages.subject: RE: Project Zephyr — technical due diligence questions
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

Answers:
1. Core v6.2 supports up to 750 concurrent AMRs per site — 180 at Lutterworth is comfortable.
2. Both adapters are production-ready; Manhattan and Blue Yonder runbooks are in the Licensed Know-How (Schedule 2).
3. P1 (production down) one-hour response, eight-hour target resolution; support 06:00–22:00 UK, seven days.
4. Yes — Helmsman Insight benefit methodology is the agreed basis (Schedule 6, Part C) and feeds the royalty under Schedule 3.

Aisha
